description: 3-in-1 module: AHT20 (temperature and humidity) + BMP280 (barometric pressure and temperature) on a shared I2C bus, headers not soldered

ports.label: VDD / GND
ports.src: aht20.supply-voltage (2,0–5,5 V); bmp280.supply-voltage.vdd (1,71–3,6 V); aht20.current.measuring 0,023 + bmp280.current.peak 0,72
ports.note: a tensão do MÓDULO não está publicada — só a de cada chip, e as faixas divergem. A confirmar antes de ligar em 5 V, que estouraria o BMP280

ports.label: I²C 0x38 + 0x76/0x77
ports.src: bmp280.communications.note (ambos os sensores no mesmo barramento I2C)
ports.note: dois endereços num único par SCL/SDA; pull-ups externos necessários (ex. 10k)

module.description: generic 4-pin AHT20+BMP280 breakout (widely cloned/rebranded design, e.g. sold as "EstarDyn AHT20+BMP280"); pin-level and voltage data below is for this common board family, not a datasheet of the exact unit purchased
module.note: board accepts 2.0-5 V even though the bare BMP280 chip tops out at 3.6 V (absolute max 4.25 V) — implies an onboard regulator feeds both chips, but neither source names the regulator IC or confirms it explicitly; pull-up presence on SDA/SCL also not confirmed (one source says pull-ups, typically 4.7k, may need to be added externally 'if not already included on the module')
module.src: https://manuals.plus/ae/1005007514986096 (EstarDyn AHT20+BMP280 user manual, working voltage DC 2.0-5V, 4-pin VDD/GND/SDA/SCL); https://docs.cirkitdesigner.com/component/3d8e6da8-841a-47a6-a1aa-0aa902c905e1/aht20bmp280 (pinout confirmation, pull-up note)

aht20.description: ASAIR AHT20 temperature and humidity sensor

timing.note: milliseconds; datasheet recommends reading no faster than once every 2 s to avoid self-heating

communications.data-format: 20-bit humidity and 20-bit temperature; RH% = S/2^20 * 100, T(C) = S/2^20 * 200 - 50

bmp280.description: Bosch Sensortec BMP280 barometric pressure and temperature sensor

pressure.note: hPa; absolute accuracy +/-1.0 hPa over 0-65 C and +/-1.7 hPa over -20-0 C; relative accuracy at 700-900 hPa and 25-40 C

bmp280.oversampling: pressure and temperature independently from x1 to x16, plus built-in IIR filter (coefficient 0 to 16)

i2c.note: SDO must not be left floating; CSB must be tied to VDDIO to select I2C

spi.modes: 4-wire and 3-wire; SPI mode 00 (CPOL = CPHA = 0) and mode 11 (CPOL = CPHA = 1), selected automatically

communications.note: on this module both sensors sit on the same I2C bus (VDD, GND, SCL, SDA header)
